titles.title: Pink Roses and Larkspur

description: Soft pink roses bloom in a cluster, surrounded by blue larkspur flowers above and green leaves below. A white daisy with a yellow center sits at the far right edge of the grouping. A smooth, grayish-white background fills the work's negative space.
title: Pink Roses and Larkspur
